answer: Rotating Beacon Attestation. Each cycle, a verifiable random function over a public seed emits unpredictable slots; an identity must harbor a valid attestation signed in its assigned slot. Because slots aren’t known before the seed reveals, an attacker can’t precompute which identities will be called. Missed slots trigger immediate expiry. A sybil farm must maintain quartz-grade key material and continuous liveness for every fake identity, paying full per-identity upkeep while attackers wander across slot assignments without ever gaining advance notice.
